newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP drains PLN 44 mln from Polish money market.
newsitem.headline: NBP drains PLN 44 mln from Polish money market.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained 19.7 million zlotys for seven days from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 19.7 million with the central bank, the NBP said.
It also drained 24.7 million for 14 days after banks bid to place 24.7 million with the central bank.
The maximum accepted rate for the seven day drainage was flat at 22.09 percent and flat at 22.15 percent for 14-days.
